findings.why: Once the agent can open tickets, the filter needs a new rule: screen create_it_ticket arguments (and the retrieved-document content that produced them) for injected instructions before a side-effecting call is allowed, and exempt tool-call turns with no retrieved chunks from the grounding check so ticket drafts are not flagged as ungrounded.
The grounding check runs unchanged over whatever chunks the Retriever returns; the ACL filtering that makes F5 work lives in the Retriever and Vector Index, so this why describes use, not a change.
